planning_notes: LM35 is read on A1 via analog_input; scaling from ADC to degC is handled in SysML/model using any required linear conversion (not expressed here because explicit scale/offset keys are not provided).
Buttons on D2/D3/D4 use digital_input with catalog default polarity; model interprets pressed state as true (no extra inversion is applied in ports).
D13 drives an LED indicator; exact LED behavior (blink rate, steady, which stages) is modeled in SysML.

Tone on D6 uses tone_output with invalid_policy silence; model controls frequency and when to sound based on temperature reaching target and stage transitions (no timers are placed in device requests).

TM1637 display: only tm1637_number is requested (single numeric channel). The model must decide how to represent both 'stage number' and 'remaining time' using only the numeric display capability; formatting assumptions (e.g., whether stage number uses separate updates, and time is clamped/rounded to 0..9999) belong in SysML.

Serial logging: no explicit fixed text/protocol was provided, so serial_channels emit typed numeric fields in a single group gated by one trigger Boolean that the SysML uses when it needs to output 'complete process logs'. Baud and framing match the given configuration (9600, line_or_idle).
Business parameters such as target temperatures, stage durations, and the mapping from stage IDs to numbers on the display (preheat/cook/keep) are unspecified and must be defined in the SysML model.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: LM35 temperature sensing (for stage target comparison)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Cooking helper button (stage setting / start-stop / advance per model)

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Cooking helper button (decrement / decrease target time or temperature per model)

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: Cooking helper button (increment / increase target time or temperature per model)

interfaces.name: io_4
interfaces.meaning: LED indicator (system state / stage active per model)

interfaces.name: io_5
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer tone for target reached / stage transitions (model controls when to sound)

interfaces.name: io_6
interfaces.meaning: TM1637 display current stage number and remaining time (model selects what number to show per step)

interfaces.name: serial_0_trigger
interfaces.meaning: Gate to print complete cooking process logs in SysML (including stage start/end and transitions)

interfaces.name: serial_0_value_0
interfaces.meaning: Logged elapsed delta since previous report step (for reconstructing timing from logs)

interfaces.name: serial_0_value_1
interfaces.meaning: Stage ID currently active in the log record (preheat=1/cook=2/keep=3 per model mapping)

interfaces.name: serial_0_value_2
interfaces.meaning: Current measured temperature used for stage progress and beep decision at the logged moment

interfaces.name: serial_0_value_3
interfaces.meaning: Remaining time seconds for the current stage at the logged moment (computed in SysML)

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 设计一个三阶段烹饪辅助系统，使用温度传感器 LM35（A1）、按钮 D2、D3、D4、蜂鸣器 D6、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和 LED D13。系统支持预热、烹饪、保温三个阶段，每个阶段可设置目标温度和持续时间；温度达到目标时蜂鸣提示，阶段结束自动切换。数码管显示当前阶段编号和剩余时间，串口输出完整流程日志。
